Hippokrates.et: From Latin Hippocratēs, from Ancient Greek Ἱπποκράτης (Hippokrátēs).

s: a kind of pastry shaped between a billhook and a horn
Hippe.et: From Middle High German heppe, happe, hipe, from Old High German heppa, hīpe, happa, from Proto-West Germanic *happjā. Compare Dutch heep.
A regional feminine or back-formation from a diminutive of Proto-West Germanic *hafr (“billygoat”).
